source: PianoCompanion.Engine.OSX.dll: ChordService.GenerateChords/AddChord, ChordSymbols.Table, ChordNamer.Difficulty (exact; derived fields computed by chord-detection.ts)
notes: ids 1-9 are scale-function chords with rootAdjustment (circle-of-fifths offset); they are never listed in the dictionary (Id > 9 filter).
ids >= 1000 are Alts variants: id = base*100 + n, n counts sus2, sus4, b5, #5, n7, b9, #9 in that order, only for flags the base sets.
inDictionary=false rows (aliases) are hidden from dictionary, search and reverse lookup.
degrees: 1-based letter distance from root with accidental relative to the major scale of the root.
